newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Senate confirmed previous vote that homosexual relations be punished with jail only when causing "public scandal". Parliament mediation commission rejected lower house ruling which punished all homosexual relations with jail terms of up to three years.
* Upper Senate house adopted draft bill on reparations to Romanian military wounded or killed in international peacekeeping missions.
* Lower Chamber of Deputies debates bill to transfer assets of youth NGOs back into state property, reversing move made after 1989 revolution.
* Parlamentary commision controlling Romanian Intelligence Service (SRI) heard SRI head Virgil Magureanu on ambiguities in SRI report regarding issues related to extremism and terrorism.
* Government will give 6.0 percent wage indexation starting October 1.

* Former premier Petre Roman, Social Democratic Union's presidential candidate in November polls registered his candidacy supported by 110,000 signatures at Central Electoral Bureau. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
